info.description: Group title, the services to feature, and an optional override for the related-cases carousel.

services.description: The carousel's cases come from here: every case study listed in these services' own 'Case studies' field is collected for the group.

relatedCaseStudies.description: Leave empty and the carousel shows every case study attached to the services above — de-duplicated, in the order those services are listed. Add cases here only when you want a different set: as soon as one is selected, that automatic selection is switched off and the carousel shows exactly these, in this order.
